prompt:
LOCAL CORRECTION OF IMAGE1. Keep the two-panel board and artistic style. USER IDENTIFIED A SPECIFIC ERROR: lower panel new city has substantial grassy forested mountain slopes; upper panorama new city at RIGHT still has barren/absent natural slopes. Fix this inconsistency.
Change ONLY the UPPER PANEL, RIGHTMOST APPROXIMATELY 35% around and BELOW the blocky teal-domed NEW-CITY CASTLE. The LOWER PANEL must remain identical, it is the reference for the landscape features that need to exist in the panorama. Upper left old-city mountain/trees/buildings/clouds, water color and all typography also stay unchanged.
MANDATORY visible correction: Under the upper-panel RIGHT CITY's terraced building complex, create an unmistakable CONTINUOUS NATURAL MOUNTAIN FLANK of substantial pale limestone rock with 2–3 wide sloping sage grass shoulders, dense-but-simple connected grey-teal rounded tree groves and a few dark cypresses, corresponding to the mountain under and beside the same new city in the lower view. This should be a clear major landscape addition, not two decorative bushes or tiny tree dots on the existing wall. New city must visibly sit ON a real green-shouldered mountain, as does old city. Show this vegetation-bearing slope on the FRONT-facing/LEFT-facing exposed castle foothill above the bay shore and beside the bridge landing, and on the OUTER RIGHT side behind and below the new-city plaza. Keep the steep parts bare and use broad patches rather than covering whole rock with grass. Connect it logically to the middle saddle and outer ridge; preserve open water gap under bridge.
BUILDINGS/TRANSIT LOCK: keep ALL top-panel buildings, roofs/dome, walls, plaza, entrance, bridge alignment/deck/pillars, stair paths, blue station roofs, curving railway, original apparent leaning/perspective and scale in EXACT SAME positions and shapes. Do not raise, relocate, redesign, repaint or engulf architecture. Natural terrain grows into currently bare rock footprint around foundations, not over stone walls, doorways, stairs, tracks, plaza or water crossing. Create enough visible exposed hillside areas between/alongside structures without changing their coordinates. Preserve bay opening and rail clearance. New plants not on roofs. No floating or unsupported building.
Match lower-panel plant species, cool grey-teal large joined canopy clusters, light yellow-sage grass clearings, pale faceted cliff material and low fluffy cloud-bank character. All styles stay simplified Oskar-inspired broad matte colour masses. Keep pale grey-cyan sea. Keep low clouds wrapping BEHIND the improved mountain flank but not covering new vegetation, domed castle or rail.
DO NOT modify lower panel. DO NOT create another panel. NO new labels, arrows, diagrams, paths or architecture. The before/after difference must be obviously NEW-CITY GREEN MOUNTAIN SLOPES PRESENT IN THE UPPER PANORAMA.
scope: Correct upper panorama new-city hillside and vegetation missing relative to lower panel. Environment concept only; no runtime modifications.
visualReview: Upper right now has clearly visible green natural shoulders, connected tree groups and rock cliffs below/alongside citadel. Main architectural identity and traffic alignments maintained in concept. Precise multi-view geometric consistency and clearances require actual 3D implementation, not asserted from raster.
